settings.weekendLabel: Separate plan for weekends and holidays
settings.appSwitch: Daylight Rhythm for the whole app
settings.appOff: Daylight Rhythm is switched off for the whole app. Lights are not controlled.
settings.noRooms: No rooms yet. Create a room and choose which lights should follow the rhythm.
settings.backupCopied: Copied. Paste the text somewhere safe, e.g. a note or an email to yourself.
settings.backupSelected: The text is selected in the field above. Copy it from there.
settings.backupPasteFirst: Paste the text of a backup into the field above first.
settings.backupInvalid: This text does not look like a Daylight Rhythm backup.
settings.backupConfirm: Tap again to replace all settings
settings.backupHint: Settings survive updates, but not uninstalling the app or resetting Homey. Copy them and keep the text. Lights re-paired afterwards must be chosen again in their rooms.
settings.weekendHint: Applies from 12:00 the day before a Saturday, Sunday or holiday until 12:00 on that day. The evening before a work day follows the weekday plan.
settings.deleteConfirm: Tap again to delete (saved when you tap Save)
settings.dialLabel: 24-hour clock with light colour and brightness
settings.dialHintKeyframes: Tap the ring to add a point. Drag a point to move it, or into the middle to delete it.
settings.dialHintSun: The ring shows the light colour, the bars the brightness. Drag the hand to look at another time.
settings.noWeekendPoints: No weekend points yet, so the weekday points (faint on the clock) are used at weekends. Tap the ring to make your own, or
settings.copyWeekdayPoints: start with a copy of the weekday points
settings.noPoints: No points yet. Tap the ring to add the first one.
settings.weekendTimesHint: At weekends and on holidays these times are used instead of the sun and the times above.
settings.noHistory: No history yet. The app logs every 2 minutes while the rhythm is on, so the graph fills up over time.
settings.historyHint: The area is what the plan asks for, in the plan’s light colour. The line is the lights that are actually on: its height is their average brightness (0 when all are off), and its colour is their actual light colour. Drag a finger across the graph to see the values. The same numbers are in Homey under Insights.
settings.chooseLightFirst: Choose at least one light in the room first.
settings.testSeconds: seconds. If a light looks different from the others, adjust its colour range.
settings.testDone: Done. The lights are back to what they had.
settings.testStopped: Stopped. The lights are back to what they had.
settings.testHint: Shows the same colour on all lights in the room, so you can compare them and adjust their colour range. Lights that are off are switched on during the test.
settings.luxSwitch: Dim the lights when there is daylight
settings.luxIntro: Uses a light sensor in the room to turn brightness down when the sun shines in, and up again when it is grey and dark.
settings.luxNoSensor: Needs a light sensor (lux). Many motion sensors measure light too. None found in Homey.
settings.luxMin: Lowest brightness in bright daylight, of the plan's
settings.luxNowMid: lux (average of last 10 min), so the lights get
settings.luxHint: Brightness only changes in the regular updates every 2 minutes, and only by more than 5 %, so the lights don't flicker when a cloud passes.
settings.wakeIntro: Lights in the room that are off come on very dim and warm before the wake time and brighten to the plan's values. Nice for the bedroom.
settings.wakeHint: Lights that are off at the start come on very dim and warm and brighten to the plan's values at the wake time. Lights already on are left alone. Switching a light off stops its wake-up. Leave the weekend time empty for no wake-up at weekends and on holidays.
settings.calNone: Not adjusted: the light gets the plan's value as it is.
settings.calSet: The light now gets the plan's colour, as far as its range allows.
settings.calInvalid: Coolest must be higher than warmest.
settings.calHint: The colour range is in the light's manual or on its product page. Applies to the light in every room.
settings.skipOff: Leave lights that are off alone
settings.fadeHint: Lights glide to new values instead of jumping. Not all lights support it. A light that is switched on gets the right values straight away.
settings.noControllable: No lights found that can be controlled (neither colour temperature nor brightness).
settings.dimOnlyWarning: Lights without colour temperature are not adjusted with “Follow the sun” until you switch on “Also adjust brightness”.
settings.colourRangeTitle: Adjust for the light's colour range, so it shows the same colour as other lights
settings.simulateTitle: Runs through the whole day in about 1 minute on the room's lights, so you see the effect straight away.
settings.loadMathFailed: Could not load circadian.js. Try reinstalling the app.
settings.missingOne: 1 light in the room no longer exists in Homey (deleted, or re-paired and given a new ID).
settings.missingMany: {n} lights in the room no longer exist in Homey (deleted, or re-paired and given a new ID).
settings.holidaysHint: Rooms with a separate weekend plan also use it on public holidays in the chosen country. Norway also includes Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve.
settings.notifyProblems: Notify in Homey when something is wrong
settings.notifyProblemsHint: A message in Homey’s timeline when a light no longer exists, a light sensor has stopped measuring, or a light cannot be updated. Each problem is told once.
settings.legendActual: Actual (its colour is the actual light colour)

app.statusReadFailed: Could not read its state from Homey
app.statusStale: Off (the app thought it was on, corrected)
app.statusOffAgain: Switched off while the app was writing, switched off again
app.notifyMissing: A light in {room} no longer exists in Homey (deleted, or re-paired and given a new ID). Remove it from the room, and choose the new one, in the Daylight Rhythm settings.
app.notifySensor: The light sensor {sensor} has measured nothing for over a day. Check its battery. Until it measures again, the lights in {room} get the plan’s brightness without daylight adjustment.
app.notifyFailing: {light} in {room} could not be updated {n} times in a row. Check that the light is available in Homey.
